The '''WESTAR-35 blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] from the [[WESTAR line|WESTAR series]] of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. As a product of the [[WESTAR blaster series|WESTAR series]] of blasters, the WESTAR-35 was the successor to the [[WESTAR-20 blaster pistol|WESTAR-20]] and [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistols]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> The WESTAR-35 was also capable of firing [[Color/Legends|yellow]] or blue bolts of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]].<ref name="TMP" /><ref name="Corruption" /> It was the favored weapon of numerous [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].

[[File:PreVizsla-SWE.png|thumb|left|180px|Pre Vizsla wielding dual WESTAR-35 pistols]]
The WESTAR-35 [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] was used around and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by several members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] wielded twin WESTAR-35 pistols as his weapons of choice, and the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] saw extensive use among the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] Vizsla commanded at [[Death Watch hideout|their base]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]].<ref name="TMP" /> [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] of the [[Mandalorian Guard|Mandalorian police]] force in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] also utilized the weapon.<ref name="Corruption" />
